purpose: I run a small specialty food company and just got approached by a regional grocery chain plus two airport stores that want to carry our products fast, but right now everything has been phone calls, texts, and handshakes. I need an agreement between my company and an outside sales / distribution partner who says they can open doors, manage retailer relationships, and help us scale nationally. We need clear commission terms on accounts they bring in, whether commissions continue if they leave, minimum activity expectations, who owns retailer contacts and sales data, whether they can also represent competitors, territory rights, reimbursement for travel / trade shows / samples, approval rules for discounting or promotions, chargebacks and returns responsibility, confidentiality around pricing and margins, use of our trademarks and packaging, food safety compliance, what happens if a retailer sues or there’s a recall, non-circumvention if they introduce chains directly to us, term and renewal, termination if they stop performing, dispute resolution, and a clean way for both sides to review edits together then sign digitally once finalized.
title: Agreement
